operator_instruction.text: 修正 bug 然後開始跑
operator_instruction.meaning: fix the blocking defect and launch the true-random full CFG0 recovery

supersedes_context: cfg0-recovery-dependency-gate-env-leak-repin-20260902 removed the GPU_QUEUE_CONTRACT env leak but a second, independent defect kept 030-033 held.

trigger.held_reason: ordering dependency notification is not delivered: 029_c2p0_slot0_neg_cfg2p5_cfg4p0_full5521.sh
trigger.root_cause: notification_receipts.validate_delivered_receipt() rebuilt the expected notifier_sha256 by hashing the LIVE notifier file (sha256_file(rec['notifier_path'])) and required a historical receipt to match it. Any later edit of notify_experiment_webhook.py therefore retroactively invalidated every previously delivered receipt.
unsatisfiable_proof: 028/029 contracts and their delivered receipts record notifier_sha256=fdf9e90a8233e06c1e2d3d8cf35a62ea6f3c0c729ff9b85c6ef439c10a89863f.
accept_guest requires the live notifier to equal 9670d61e; the 029 dependency receipt check required the same live file to equal fdf9e90a.
No single file content satisfies both gates, so the queue alternated between 'notification notifier hash mismatch' at accept and 'ordering dependency notification is not delivered' at preflight.

allowed: Bind a delivered receipt's notifier_sha256 to the notifier sha declared by that receipt's own contract instead of re-hashing the live notifier file.
Re-pin notification_receipts.helper_sha256 in the four affected contracts to the amended helper.
forbidden: Change data, checkpoint, seed, hyperparameters, CFG, solver steps, precision, mask mode, metrics, thresholds, or queue order.
Relax any other preflight, storage, or ordering gate.
Modify lib_scheduler.py or any already-running job.

change.gate_still_enforced: Receipt kind, delivered state, contract path/sha, experiment_id, run_id, launcher sha, event, status and the tamper-evident payload_sha256 (which covers notifier_sha256) are all still verified. Live-notifier drift is still caught at accept time by lib_scheduler.accept_guest, which hashes the notifier against the launching contract.
change.security_rationale: A delivered receipt is historical evidence about a finished run. Its integrity comes from payload_sha256 over the recorded fields, not from mutable disk state; re-hashing the live file added no attack resistance and created a deadlock.

queue_effect: 030 -> 031 -> 032 -> 033 resume in their preregistered order; no reordering, no new work.
